description: Gold, silver or copper MINER ETFs as ranked EU-UCITS and US shortlists with TER, index, size and drawdown, plus a pick and its reason. Ranked by cost, not return, and comparable only within one list. The metal itself is get_gold_drivers.

include_notes.description: Include the per-row prose (whenToChoose, caveat, contrast, availability, venue, entryCost) and the traps list. Default false — static copy; describe_dataset carries it.

include_series.description: Include each row's 60-point price sparkline. Default false — the series are most of the payload's bytes.

market.description: Narrow to one market: 'eu' (EUR UCITS lines, buyable by EU retail) or 'us' (US-domiciled, reference only). Omit for both.

name: get_miners
